headline: A federal law renames a Ann Arbor, Michigan Postal Service facility the Robert Hayden Post Office.
what_it_does: This law names a U.S. Postal Service building at 2075 West Stadium Boulevard in Ann Arbor, Michigan, the Robert Hayden Post Office. It changes only the official name of the facility. It does not change postal services, hours, or rules.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on October 1, 2024.
